description: The official latest Mass Mobilization event files, current universe, and supplementary Coding Procedure remain unverified; this unit uses the provisional assignment and the documented historical May 2015 manual/protocol.
required_followup: Compare against the verified official event files and obtain the supplementary Coding Procedure when available.

description: Open web search does not reproduce the original LexisNexis newspaper protocol or establish exhaustive coverage.
required_followup: Review against the original newspaper frame and systematic archives if access becomes available.

description: Searches used Spanish terms and one limited Guarani-form query (“Paraguái jasyteĩ … ñemongu’e”); the returned results contained no clear Guarani-language protest coverage. This does not assess full Guarani media or source availability.
required_followup: If a comprehensive language pass is feasible, consult fluent Guarani search terms and local-language news/social archives; do not treat this limited search as evidence of absence.

description: Opened CIVICUS Monitor page covers land-rights activity and doctor/teacher labor protests in September–October 2021 plus a January 2022 anti-vaccine gathering; inspected passages provide no January 2021 event evidence.
required_followup: Continue January-specific searches in local press and sectoral sources; do not treat this later-date page as evidence of absence.

description: Opened portions of the CODEHUPY 2021 report cite March, July, and September–October protest activity, but the displayed passages do not establish a January event and do not represent a complete document search.
required_followup: Continue January-specific local press, labor, health, education, land, and regional searches; do not infer absence from the inspected excerpts.

description: The Última Hora campesino/Indigenous mobilization search hit was published 22 March 2021, outside the unit. Web open returned Cache miss; one allowed exact-URL HTTPS retry returned HTTP 200, but the bounded output preview did not expose substantive article text.
required_followup: No January coding follow-up; if the March episode is in scope elsewhere, that unit should obtain and review the article body through an allowed access path.

description: ABC Color documents a renewed Encarnación paseros blockade beginning 30 November 2020 and continuing into 1 December; it notes a January subsidy installment but no January protest. No evidence yet shows this episode continued physically into the unit month.
required_followup: Search January local/regional reporting for renewed paseros or border-worker gatherings; do not infer continuation from the future payment date.

description: CIVICUS describes January 2021 armed-civilian threats/attacks on Rosarino families but the same passage dates a shooting to 9 January 2020; no mass public gathering is described.
required_followup: If the incident is revisited, consult the cited contemporaneous report for chronology; it is excluded here because the source describes violence against families, not a public protest.

description: CIVICUS Spanish and English pages S005 and S006 are translations/variants from the same publisher and report, not independent corroboration.
required_followup: Treat the two URLs as one reporting origin; seek the cited original source only if the incident chronology becomes relevant.

description: ABC Color’s 20 January pre-event article announced the Encarnación merchant march; a same-day report confirms that merchants and employees marched and decided to maintain a vigil at the bridge entrance. The report does not give physical end or duration.
required_followup: Search 21–22 January local reporting for whether the vigil continued or ended; do not infer an end from the decision to maintain it.

description: No attendee count or reliable qualitative turnout description is provided for the announced 20 January demonstration; affected businesses/workers are not turnout.
required_followup: Find event-day reporting or organizer documentation that gives an attendance estimate or supports the 50-person threshold.

description: The 31 January Asunción escrache is described only as a group of young PLRA supporters; no attendance count establishes 50 people.
required_followup: Find event-day reporting, images with reliable caption context, or organizer records that support a numerical or clearly qualitative 50-person threshold.

description: The 31 January escrache protested a TSJE minister’s vote about the PLRA’s internal electoral tribunal. The action targeted a state official, but the state electoral-process versus party-internal dispute boundary needs review.
required_followup: Review the original Coding Procedure and contemporaneous accounts of the TSJE decision before settling the demand category and state-target eligibility.

description: No state response to the 31 January gathering or physical end is reported; throwing eggs and toilet paper is noted but source-codebook treatment as protester violence is unresolved.
required_followup: Seek event-specific follow-up reporting for departure, arrests, police action, injury/property damage, or explicit state engagement.

description: Reports confirm IPS doctors mobilizing outside the institution on 3–5 January, but provide no attendee count; numbers of terminated or employed doctors are workforce/dispute counts, not turnout.
required_followup: Seek reliable event-day estimates or organizer records for the gatherings; do not convert the affected workforce into attendance.

description: The 31 December article says staggered stoppages were already ongoing, while January sources document outside gatherings on 3–5 January. The first physical onset is unknown, and it is unresolved whether those January gatherings continued the same physical episode or were distinct actions. Reports conflict on a planned strike date (8 January versus 11–13 January); a 6 January meeting reportedly lifted the 8 January plan but does not establish when prior gatherings physically ended.
required_followup: Check late-December chronology, 8–13 January event-day reporting, and later follow-up; resolve whether the January gatherings are continuation or distinct days and record physical end only if documented.

description: The 15 January ABC Color result concerns legal proceedings over an earlier 2020 vehicle caravan; the news publication date is not the event date.
required_followup: No January follow-up unless a separate source places a new gathering in the unit month.

description: La Nación items S011, S013, S019, S020 and Última Hora items S014, S015 are same-publisher sources; some statements are repeated from the same doctors or IPS officials. Count outlet-level corroboration carefully.
required_followup: Keep publisher and quoted-source relationships explicit; use distinct outlets as corroboration only when their reporting basis is independent.

description: Sources describe a 8 January strike plan later lifted on 6 January, while an IPS statement reproduced by HOY cites a 11–13 January strike set at a 4 January assembly. No source reviewed confirms execution of either future strike plan.
required_followup: Search exact event-day reports for 8–13 January and preserve the differing announcement dates until resolved.

description: The same IPS dispute includes a separately reported 7 December mobilization. Similar demands and organizers do not prove that the 7 December protest and January stoppage series were one uninterrupted physical event.
required_followup: Review December day-level reports and physical breaks before joining the December 7 mobilization to the late-December/January series.

description: ABC Color S007 and same-day S022 are pre-event and event-day reports from the same outlet and likely the same Encarnación correspondent; the latter confirms occurrence but is not independent outlet corroboration.
required_followup: Retain both reports for temporal distinction; seek a genuinely independent local source for turnout/end if available.

description: ABC Color reports that IPS resident and contracted doctors held a 4 January assembly and planned a future strike. The assembly is now retained as candidate E003 with pending_evidence status: reviewed evidence does not establish its venue, whether it was public/open, or its turnout. Separate reporting documents outside-IPS mobilizations on 3–5 January (E004). Whether E003 was part of those mobilizations, and whether E004 continues the pre-January stoppage series in C001, remain unresolved.
required_followup: Review fuller contemporaneous accounts or an official/organizer account for E003 venue, public access, and attendance; determine whether E003 and E004 were physically distinct or part of one sequence and how that sequence relates to C001. Keep E003 pending_evidence until public status and threshold are supported; do not force a merge or exclude it as a verified nonqualifier.

description: El Independiente reports a completed Partido Paraguay Pyahura mobilization in Asunción and Villarrica, but its 28 January header conflicts with “yesterday Thursday.” Última Hora’s 27 January 22:00 header conflicts with its “today” call text. Both support a January action, but exact day cannot be resolved.
required_followup: Seek same-week independent reporting or organizer records for the exact day and attendance; preserve month-level date until resolved.

description: The same article announces a separate Itaipú 2023 Causa Nacional action at Mburuvicha Róga as “today Friday,” despite a 28 January page header; no reviewed report confirms that it occurred. This remains source-only pending_evidence E006.
required_followup: Search contemporaneous 28–30 January reporting for execution, turnout, exact date, physical end, and state response; do not treat the call as an event.

description: Última Hora S024 reproduces the Partido Paraguay Pyahura call/communiqué for the same “Che Kuerái” action; it independently records the call but is not independent event-occurrence or turnout corroboration for El Independiente S023.
required_followup: Seek a distinct contemporaneous source describing actual attendance at either site and resolve the calendar-date discrepancy.

description: Boundary searches found separate announced February actions: the “Ko’ág̃a reikuaáta” calls for 5 February in Asunción/Encarnación and 10 February in Ciudad del Este, plus future Partido Paraguay Pyahura mobilizations from 5 February. These dates are after the unit, and no evidence links them as an uninterrupted physical continuation of the January actions E001, E005, or E006. The February 23 Encarnación border-worker blockade is also after a documented gap; do not infer January-to-February continuity from shared city/sector/demand alone.
required_followup: The February unit should examine the specific later actions and their physical dates. For this January unit, keep them outside month and avoid merging without evidence of an uninterrupted physical episode.
